defaultIntents: Complex work where quality matters, decisions, or work where a mistake is costly.

model.instructions: An AI agent receives `new_message`. Decide which model it should use. `previous_reply`, when present, shows its latest reply.

An AI agent receives `new_message`. Decide which model it should use. The agent is currently on `current_model`, and `previous_reply` shows its latest reply. Switching models throws away cached work, so choose another model only when `new_message` clearly needs it. Follow-ups, confirmations, corrections and continuations of the latest reply belong to the current model.

target.instructions: Choose exactly one agent to receive state.new_message verbatim. Use state.roster and its recent task context. Do not rewrite the message, answer it, or select multiple agents. route to that latest_reply agent unless new_message clearly addresses another agent's work.

Choose exactly one agent to receive state.new_message verbatim. Match the new message to the routing condition for each agent in state.roster. Use the supplied conditions and state.latest_reply, not assumptions about names or other conversation history. route to that latest_reply agent unless new_message clearly matches another agent's condition.
